invariants: A Claim is a value, not a guard: dropping it does nothing on the server.
claim returns Ok(None) when the server returns SQL NULL (nothing claimable) - never an error.
No method builds SQL beyond the fixed function-call strings in the signature.
responsibilities: Claim::from_json decodes the claim payload; a missing or mistyped required field is a Protocol error naming the field. Optional payload fields stay in raw.
WorkerApi methods call exactly the SQL functions named in the signature comments, in the session's owner-scoped transaction, via PgSession's call_* helpers.
renew_status probes to_regprocedure for the typed function and falls back to boolean renew (Renewed/LeaseExpired) when it is absent.
publish probes publish_with_cause only for outcome "failed" with a cause, and otherwise calls publish.
RenewStatus::parse accepts exactly the five statuses and rejects anything else as Protocol.
summary: The worker surface: Claim (the lease), RenewStatus, and WorkerApi - typed calls over forge_coding_worker_api, one function per method, mirroring WorkerDB's worker role.
